claim_text: The pinned release has 7016 annotated replies across 2111 distinct conversation IDs.
Conversation and utterance ID intersections are zero across all official split pairs.
Train and test share four exact normalized traces and two nonexact candidate pairs at the specified similarity threshold.
All released prefixes parsed and were consistent with recorded positions and observed longer traces.
The proposed exclusions cover nine train, three development, and eight test conversations.
The proposed label and matched boundary evidence interventions require independent human judgments.
Human validation yield and confirmatory paired detector performance are pending.
The filtered lexical development audit trained on 4185 replies and evaluated on 1393 replies from 420 conversations.
Reply-only macro-F1 was 0.610 and full-prefix macro-F1 was 0.614. The paired 95% interval for the difference was [-0.030, 0.038].
Altered prefix probes changed predictions under the fixed full-prefix fit. Their expected gold relations remain unvalidated.
The development queue contains 50 source conversations and 100 edit slots.
